text: On May 5, 1965, Customs seized 260 advance copies of John McGahern's The Dark in Dublin, before its official publication date. The Dark was banned in Ireland for obscenity during McGahern's leave from his Clontarf school, which began in autumn 1964. The ban lapsed in 1972.
